description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three different models—XLM-R, chLSTM, and a third model represented by light blue bars—across various linguistic categories labeled on the horizontal axis: L1, L2, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis, labeled "Shapley value," ranges from 0 to 80, with gridlines at intervals of 20. The data shows that the Shapley values are generally low for most categories, with the exception of the 'T' category, where all three models exhibit significantly higher values. In the 'T' category, the chLSTM model (green bars) has the highest Shapley value, exceeding 80, followed by XLM-R (dark blue bars) with a value of approximately 75, and the light blue model with a value around 80. For all other categories, the Shapley values are much lower, with the light blue model generally having the highest values among the three, followed by XLM-R and then chLSTM. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars representing the three models, and the legend in the top right corner identifies the models by color. The chart is rotated, with the x-axis labels oriented diagonally.
